disclaimer: This catalog contains fictional example content for demonstrating a static tool call. It is not an event schedule or a recommendation service.
selectionPurpose: Demonstrate deterministic tool use alongside cross-framework A2A collaboration.

sessions.title: Designing a cross-framework agent boundary
sessions.summary: A practical introduction to separating agent responsibilities and using an open protocol for collaboration.

sessions.title: Building a document retrieval assistant
sessions.summary: Covers metadata, document profiles, retrieval trade-offs, and safe defaults for a small knowledge catalog.

sessions.title: Operating long-running agent workflows
sessions.summary: Explores task state, cancellation, continuation, timeouts, and observable workflow design.

sessions.title: Secure service-to-service agent calls
sessions.summary: Explains workload identity, least-privilege authorization, and authenticated runtime invocation patterns.

sessions.title: AgentCard design for discoverable specialists
sessions.summary: Shows how agents publish clear skills, capabilities, input modes, and transport metadata.

sessions.title: Tracing multi-agent task execution
sessions.summary: Uses structured events and traces to follow delegation, artifacts, failures, and retries across agents.

sessions.title: Using tools without exposing agent internals
sessions.summary: Demonstrates how a specialist can use private tools while exposing only results through a stable agent contract.

sessions.title: From prototype to managed agent runtime
sessions.summary: Discusses packaging, authentication, monitoring, and deployment choices for independently operated agents.

sessions.title: Evaluating agent collaboration patterns
sessions.summary: Compares handoff, supervisor, delegation, and peer collaboration patterns for specialized agents.

sessions.title: Hybrid retrieval for small knowledge catalogs
sessions.summary: Explains when metadata filtering, keyword search, and embeddings are useful for a compact document collection.

sessions.title: Controlling cost and latency in agent systems
sessions.summary: Reviews model selection, response budgets, caching, and latency-aware design decisions.

sessions.title: Testing agent protocol contracts
sessions.summary: Shows deterministic tests for AgentCards, task transitions, error handling, and artifact order.

sessions.title: Handling missing context in autonomous workflows
sessions.summary: Uses explicit input requests and resumable tasks instead of hidden assumptions or brittle callbacks.

sessions.title: Model-agnostic agent architecture
sessions.summary: Designs agents that can change model providers without changing their collaboration contract.

sessions.title: Applying policy to agent tool calls
sessions.summary: Introduces guardrails, policy checks, and least-privilege design for agent actions.

sessions.title: Designing artifacts for downstream agents
sessions.summary: Explains how named artifacts make agent outputs reusable by people, workflows, and other agents.
